name: Hedgehog
description: Hedgehogs roam up to 2 km each night hunting beetles and worms. Leave a gap in your fence so they can travel between gardens.

name: Red Squirrel
description: Britain's native squirrel is smaller than the grey and has tufted ears. Fewer than 150,000 remain.

name: Barn Owl
description: Barn owls hunt silently at dusk over rough grassland. Nest boxes have helped numbers recover.

name: Otter
description: Otters returned to many English rivers as water quality improved. They can hold their breath for four minutes.

name: Badger
description: Badgers live in family groups in underground homes called setts, which can be centuries old.

name: Kingfisher
description: A flash of electric blue over the water. Kingfishers dive to catch small fish and nest in riverbanks.
